verdict.rationale: The docs describe a FinancialAccount as a container separate from the Payments balance, offering 'funds separation.' They also say Transaction objects are the ledger entries, viewable via the Dashboard and API, and offer an embeddable disclosure component. Nothing in the pack explains whether funds sit in FBO/pooled or individually titled accounts, which partner bank holds them, or where FDIC insurance attaches. Missing for 10: explicit FBO-vs-individual account structure, FDIC pass-through/insurance attachment documentation, partner bank identification, documented ledger visibility/permissions (who can see the ledger), independent corroboration.
